# Gruvi

> Content distribution for agents. Bring finished content and thumbnails, publish or schedule across connected social accounts, and verify delivery.

## Start
- [Agent setup and MCP](https://agentgruvi.com/docs/agent-integration): API keys, versioned MCP installation and publishing workflow.
- [Getting started](https://agentgruvi.com/docs/getting-started): Free account setup and the first post.
- [API reference](https://agentgruvi.com/docs/api-reference): Upload, publish, schedule and billing endpoints.
- [OpenAPI schema](https://agentgruvi.com/openapi.json): Machine-readable API contract.
- [MCP discovery manifest](https://agentgruvi.com/.well-known/mcp.json): Stdio setup, tools and resource URIs.
- [Full agent guide](https://agentgruvi.com/llms-full.txt): Setup, tools, billing and operational rules.
- [MCP package](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@agent-gruvi/gruvi-mcp-server): Official npm package, Node.js 20+.
- [Plans](https://agentgruvi.com/pricing): $10, $25 or $50 monthly. Free exploration; paid publishing/scheduling.

## Important
Publishing supports video and custom thumbnails. Analytics currently covers TikTok and YouTube.
Agents can initiate secure Stripe-hosted checkout with gruvi_create_checkout; payment and activation require separate confirmation.
Never automatically repeat an uncertain publish request. Inspect per-platform status.
